# Expected extraction trees for the RAR fixtures in this directory.
#
# Baseline decoder: the `unrar` 0.5 crate (bundled UnRAR C++), i.e. the
# backend hok used before the `rars` swap. A `D` line is a directory, an
# `F` line is a file followed by the SHA-256 of its extracted bytes.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   cargo test -p libscoop --lib rar_regenerate_golden_baseline -- --ignored --exact
#
# Every line here is a claim the new backend has to reproduce exactly;
# review the diff before accepting a regeneration.
